question: waddi bingel amma duɓi je naya nyautarde hande nyau mali ɓingel on siro soja naya goɗɗo amma bo saun ngati maddi cugale on wuro ɓe hitti mora puti fu tare to bo saru ɗon ngati cugale on mi tari fu tare noni bo ɗuti mi waɗi dabo findiraɓe mo andi bo saro gonati ɓingel on jonbo saru ɗo. Ɓe meɗa hokkugo ɓosaru on je ɓe wi ɗum yaha yasi ɗum fija ɗum wartetan ɓe wi ɓe meɗa hokkugo bol saru ɗum ni kesum kanjum waɗi mi holi sei mi yaha waɗugo ɓingel on nyotode ngam to bo saru ɗon ngati cukare on no wawi no wodi nyobo saru ɗum ɓe heɓata ɓingel ko bo saru ngatiko ɗume wawan. bana nyausaru wawi nasta nder futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sappunga bosaru on kodume mi waye wadugo gam to nyau nata futere on nanda he lekki ha hokka bingel on gam heba jamu ko dumai goddum mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi waɗan gof. to sare do ngati bingel on.
reference: Mi waddi bingel am mo dubi jenayi Nyaurdorde hanne ƴaloma. Mi lili bingel on siri sooda Naƴam goɗun amma bosaaru ngati mo. De ɓe waddi cukaley on wuro ɓe hecci am ko fayti , Mi raɓɓuti futtere to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on,Mi tawi futtere non wujji bo ɓuuti.  Men waɗi ƴamde  dere keddiraɓe mo andi bosaaru nga ƴati bingel on. Joom bosaaru ɗun wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru on Njibinanɗe .Ɓe wi'i ɗun yaha yasi dun  fija ɗu warta tan. Ɓe wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru ɗun lekki sam. Kanjum waɗi  mi huli se mi yaawi wadduko bingel on Nyaurdorde, gan to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on no wodi ƴau bosaaru . Ɗume  heɓɓata bingel ko bosaaru ngati bo?  Ɗume wawi heɓɓa  futtere wojju ɗun e ɓuutu ɗun? Nƴau bana ƴau bosaaru waawi nasta dere futere? Ko waawi waɗɗuko bingel on sabun ngati bosaaru on? Tii, ko ɗume mi waawi waɗɗuko ngan to nƴau nata futtere on? Ɗume Njibinanɗe e lekki haani hokka bingel on gan hebɓe Jam? Ko ɗume goɗɗum min waawi waɗɗuko wala ko lekki min waawi waɗɗanko futtere ɗen to bosaaru ɗun ngati ɓingel on?
model_answer: A yahi welli e ɗaɓɓude ballal; ngam heɓugo jam ɓingel on, hokku mo ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam walla ORS e ñaamdu no feewi hara a hokkata mo fannu fannu. Si tawii ɓingel on no wuli, a wawi ɓoytugo mo e ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam, kadi a hokku mo lekki wuldu (paracetamol) no ɓe mbi'ruɗo on hokkugo on. Nyau nasta nder futere no haani lekki tiiɗɗo (antibiotics), si ɓe hokkaama on lekki on, a haani timminugo ɗum hara a taƴataa. Si a yiyii ɓingel on no fusa fusu, o wawataa yarde, walla o heɓataa semmbe, a haani ruttitugo ɗum e saare mawɗo (hospital) law law. Hakkillo ma no fewwi, ndaara ɓingel on no fewwi, kadi a hokku mo hakkiilo haa o heɓa jam.

question: Debbo je joɗata ha sare amin o ɗo huwa ɗo waɗa kugal oɗo waɗa kugal mako boɗɗum bo o wala nyau yende fere wakkati o ɗo yiwa en mako ɗo mari hunde petel satinga hala. O laari o nanyi ɗum fahin fahin ɗo wakkati o dillai wakkati ɗo dilla o fuɗɗi nuɗɗi damuwa be mai sosai o fuddi on ha en. Nau amma babal mai ɗo safiti bo sare je mari ɗum ha endiije sali sati je sali o yidi o yahi larugo. Oki o yiɗi o anda ɗume on dasi ɗum de onta hala mai emdi jemma e ji mako mai on dasata hunde mai ha en debbo ko ɗume on je sati. Nda ha en ɗi nasa on debbo lora ta lara fahin ha en ɗi mai.
reference:
Debbo je jodata ha sare amen, do huwa.
Do wada kuugal maako  boddum bo o wala yeiwu. Yende fera, waakati odo yiwa, o nane endi maako dou mari hunde petel satinga hader. O numi wala ko duma , o lori o nane dun fahen yende fera fahen do . Waakati do dellal, o fudi damugo be mai sosai, o fudi numugo dimai on ha endi maako. Wala nawa mo, amma balal mai do sati bo sali dellu go. O fudi num tugo labari je binkon robe je mari don ha endi mabe. Sati je sali,  o yeti larugo likita.  O kidi o anda dumi on dasi dum be dume on o wadata hala mai. Made jima: dumi on dasata hunde mai ha endi debbo? Koh dume o je satin ga  ha endi on na cancer? Dume on debbo lora ta lara fahim ha endi mai?
model_answer: Debbo on o mari nyau nder reedu (PID), te o foti heɓugo safaruuji (antibiotics) bana ceftriaxone e metronidazole ngam warugo bakteriaji ɗin. Safaruuji ɗin ko kamji ɓuri huutoreede ha Afirka ngam saakugo nyau PID, sabu ɗi mari doole warugo bakteriaji addi nyau ndu. O foti daina jimaade e gorko makko haa safaruuji ɗin fow timma, ngam haɗugo nyau ndu ruttugo walla yaɓɓugo haa o mari. Ko hawti e ɗum, gorko makko ne o foti heɓugo safaruuji ngam haɗugo yaɓɓugol nyau ndu hakkunde maɓɓe. Si ɗum waɗi, nyau ndu on ma laaɓa fow, te debbo on ma o heɓugo cellal.

question: Debbo rediyo mo duɓi sappan me tati mo woodi redu leddi je ɗiɗi keddu e mako en galju mako ɗuɗɗi wodi yeso mako woya gauna ɗum wodi sembe mako sara’en mako bibbe sara en mako. Tawa daada ko ɓingel arande nyauto nyamde ɗiɗaɓre hani waɗugo ɓe lau ha debbo redujo on nyamrita tare ɗume hani pat o hefta nyau ɗum yamre nayare irin lekki kiya hani nyau dami o waɗata. ɗum daye hani o hutira.
reference:
Debbo reedujo mo dubi sappane tati e tati mo wodi reedu lebbi jeeɗiɗi keddu en makko ngaddimo Nyaurdorde amin. Ɓe wi'i  reedu mako no nawɗum tenduɗum, ƴiiyan ko ɗuɗi wurti le yeso mako. Ii 'o diwna ,I'o woya ngam nawɗun dun ɓurimo semɓe.  Saro en makko mbii be don kultori ta godɗun tawa Dada ko bingel ngel.

Ƴamnde arandere nde Nyautowo ƴami :  dume on wadi reedu naawurta non ha ma ƴiiƴam wurto e sembe?
Ƴamnde ɗi dabre: Dume haani waɗugo ɓelau ha debbo reedujo on?
Ƴamre tataure: Dume haani raɓɓu tugo hefta nyau dum?
Ƴamre Nayabre: Irin lekki kiye haani nyaudiramo?
Ƴamre Joyabre: ira Nyamdu nduye o woɗoto, nden bo ira ngendam dayeejam haani o hutira?
model_answer: Debbo redujo on hani nyamda ñaamdu heftinooru sembe, wa'i no teebu e leɗɗe, kadi o heɓa lekki iron e folic acid ngam safrude ɗum nyau woyngo sembe. Kadi o hani safreede nyau fura (malaria) e heɓugo lekki ɓeydoowo sembe, sabu duɓi mako e redu leɗɗe ɗiɗi ɗin ɗon ɗaɓɓi reenoore mawnde. O hani yahugo asibiti fahin fahin ngam ɓe ƴeewto ɗum no feewi, o wurtugo golla tiiɗɗi ngam o reena sembe mako. So tawii ɗum woya sembe mako haa heewi, o hani yaha asibiti mawnudo ngam ƴeewugo ɗum e heɓugo ƴiiam so ɗum hani.

question: Jam ɓandu likita waddi bingal amin larin no o fofata ɗon woni bana sautu hendu ɗo sala babal petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo dake o fofata milliti bo balɗe tati jotta o ɗo ɗotta be jamma wakkati fere mi ɗo lara ɓe ɗo nasta sosai. Ɗo sosai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako seto o naftira sembe mako o hokkata mi lari bo o wala nyama banani to o nyamai fu sauto nyamai fu sau to o nangi pofɗe mako seto nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokka tame oɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati. Mi arti mi yari mo kemis petel ha fattude amin be hokki mo lekki dojugo gam o dodda sedda sedda amma dojugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mofugo mako bannin kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boddum irin damuwa damata bingel am be fofugo mako do bana hendu do sala babal pitu ni o. To handini hotina heɓa famta ko damata mo be kwali ɓerde mako ɗo faɗa jippa ɗum irin nyaundi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha sare hoinina mo heɓa o fofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji fere sibiti na ko hundeji tan fere mataki je hosata hado ɓingel ɗo.
reference:
Jam bandu likita, useni mi waddi bingel am sibiti gam mi laari no o foofata, don woni bana sawtu hendu do saala babal petel ni, donbo bana goddo don fuufa hunde, be daker o foofata. Mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta odo dojja be jamma. Wakati fere mido lara berde mako do nasta sosai lugga, do fa’a do sosai bana saito naftiri sembe mako o foofata. Milaribo owala yaama banaane.
To o yammai fu saito onangi fofde mako. Irin bani mai don hokkatamo bone odo kasa yamugo boddum balle tati jotta. Mi arti mi yari mo chemist petel ha fattude amin, be hokkimo lekki dojjugo gam odo dojja sedda sedda, amma dojjugo mai hallai .
Amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafimo.
Foofugo mako bannin ni, kuma harjotta o wawata yamugo boddum. Useni irin damuwa toidamata mingel am be foofugo mako do bana hendu do saala babel piitum?
Useni o haadini hooto na? Heba famta ko daamata mo be kwadi berde mako do fada jippa do?
Irin yaudigi toi mihokkata mingel do ha sare, hoininamo heba o foofa boddum?
Don irin lekkiji fere sibiti na ko hundeji tan fere mataaki je hosata hado bingel do?
model_answer: Bingel maa ɗon e rafi mawɗo bi'eteeɗo pneumonia (fofugo ɓandu) sabu o waawaa fofude, ɗum ɗon holla wonde o ɗon e maayde so o heɓaani balal law. A haani a nawra mo hospital law ngam o heɓa oxygen e lekki nyau (antibiotics) ɗi njippinta e ɓandu. Lekki aada e paracetamol njaɓataa rafi fofugo, ko hospital tan waawi wallude mo. Haa o ɗon hospital, ɓe njippinan mo ndiyam e ñaamdu rewrude e tiifre (NG tube) sabu o waawaa ñaamugo. A haanaa jippaago, nawru mo law ngam o heɓa balal ngam o wura.

question: Goɗɗo ɓe nodeta suberu duɓi mako sappan ɗe joyi nyande mum fere o fuddi nyouru arande bo yori ɗum nyadai amma de ɗum fabi asawai je sedda tan yarugo lebbi be hakkilo ɗum yahi ɗum hallobi sedda sai ɗum salda rimopde ɗum gonga on o habdi bauɗe ko o wawata inde ko nyauru ɗon satai amma. Pat manju ɗum wadai da ha nu o nyaɗita yonru de o hilliti dow o yaha o soda lekki dikka o yaha nyaudo o yawto o yokki nyaurde o hecci ɓe ɗo jalibi tati ko sali o lori fahin o hecci ɓe o hafti ko o wawata waɗugo bana ko himɓe shawari mo ko larani jumri ndiyam fowuɗam goro jum. Ɗo heɓe lekki ɗuɗi ka ko o suɗi da ha nuno o nyaɗita sei nyouru wari tullitti ɗum yottike wakkati fere fu mahe salda roɗi sei o nyami nyautawo on ko waɗi nyoru ɗum neɓuri bana ni salo yamɗetugo o yidi o anda ko waɗi dabare be leɗɗe ɗe o fuɗi fu nafi. oyam ɗume o wannata yoru ɗon yamɗita ɗo fu maru gam o heɓa o fufa no hani olollita jamu bandu makko.
reference:
Goɗɗo ɓeno data Suberu, duɓi mako sappaɗe joyi, ƴande fere ofuuɗi ƴowru. Arande bo ,ƴowru ɗun ƴaaɗai amma  de ɗun faɓɓi asaweje seeɗa tan yarigo lebbi, be hakkiilo ni ɗun yehi ɗun Halloi. De neɓi seeɗa , se saldorimo bobɗe . Ɗun goĝa on o habdi bauɗe ko o wawata hinddeeko nyouru dun satayi amma ɗun pat manju ɗun waɗai. Da hanuno o ƴamɗita ,ƴowru tulliti. De O hilliti ,dou o yaha o soda lekki dikka o yaha  Nyaurdorde o yi'a Nyautowo. Nde o yokki  Nyaurdorde ,o yecci ɓe ,o ɗou ɗojja lebi tati ko saali.  O lori  fa hin ,o hecci ɓe o habdi ko wawata waɗuko bana ko hiɓɓe shawarimo ko larini jumri, diyan fowuɗan ,goroju-kaɗɗu,e ɓe lekki ɗuɗuki ko o soodi . Da hanuno ,O nyamɗinta se ŋyowru wari tulliti. Ɗun yottaki wakkati feere, fofugo ma e saldoramo ngam ŋyouru ɗum ƴaɗi . Se O ƴami Nyautowo on ,ko waɗi ƴowru ndum neɓir bana ni,sali yamɗutuko. O yinno o anda ko waɗi dabareji be leɗɗe ɗe o foodi fu ko nafayi .
Ragare mai ,on nƴami ɗume o wannata ƴowru dum ɗu nyamɗita dufuumaru ,ngam o heɓa o foofa no hani  o lorinita jamo bandu mako.
model_answer: Ñawu nguu ina waawi wonde malaria tiiɗɗo naatuɗo e huɓeere (cerebral malaria) walla meningitis, ko ɗum waɗi o haanaa ɗaɓɓude safaara aadaaji ɗii kadi o nawree ospitaal law. Safaara aada walla ndiyam goro waawaa warde mborosu naatɗo e ƴiiƴam walla e huɓeere, te ina waawi ɓeydude ñawu nguu. Omo haani nawreede e nokku cellal ngam ƴeewtaade ƴiiƴam makko, heɓde lekki mborosu tiiɗɗo (hono IV artesunate) walla antibiotik so tawii ko meningitis. So o heɓii safara modern oo law, o ma foofta, kono so o jibbiima, nguurndam makko ina waawi tarnaade.

question: Dada debbo je danyi neɓai wari sibiti o vi tun ɓingal mako dayi odo ta rufa iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako denbo mo danyi mai dubi mako nogas e nai o vi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi nyamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodum. Yonde amjum ɗum waddata debbo ninga rufugo iyam ɗo ɓawo dayi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaundiku toi ɓe hokkata dada mai je rufugo iyam mai darata denbo o lorna sembe mako shawara hokkata dada mai be ɓingel mako.
reference:
Dada debbo je dayi nebai wari sibiti . Ovi tun bingel mako dayi odota rufa eyam sosai.
Kanjum wadi owala sembe ha bandu mako.
Debbo mo dayi mai dubi mako nogas e ni. Ovi bo rufugo eyam mai duudi masin denta bo watamo owala sembe.
Daada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodume.
Demde am kanjum dumedon waddata debbo ninga rufugo eyam do bawo o dayi balde sedda sali do? 
Yaudiku toi be hokkata daada mai je rufugo eyam mai darata denbo olorna sembe mako? Shawara toi hokkata daada mai be bingel mako?
model_answer: Ɗum ko rufugo iyam addani mo ɓuyuki ƴiiƴam e waasugo sembe, sabu ƴiiƴam mo rufi o heɓaaki fartaŋŋe artude. Kasi bandu e kodum o hollata ko waawi wonde maayde walla ƴiiƴam ɗam o waasaaki heɓugo. Shawara o hokkata mo sembe seeɗa, kono so ƴiiƴam ɗam rufi, sembe makko fof ruttata. A wi'a dada o nyaama nyamdu ɓeydoowo ƴiiƴam bana keɓe, ɓaleeji, e saayeeji, o heɓa safaara ƴiiƴam e antibiotik. Ɓingel makko wi'a odo nyaama nono maako tan haa o heɓa sembe e mawnugo moƴƴugo.

question: Dottijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo vi o ɗo nana hore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiɗi be kuma fofe peppetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari ammugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawatoi hokkata mo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko sedda sedda warin. Dottijo mai vi warini mo jamma den bo halli jotta min emi mo bo o do lara hite na o vi a gam hite o tull mo nawol hore min nemi mo fu hala fufe ha bandu mako ko do nawa sosai ko sedda sedda dottijo mai vi fu finimo patdu be kuma o wawata viwugo da pellel. vilel gotel amma ɗo nyamo ɓawo kanjum min emi mo ko o fotti be nyaudo o vi wala ha o yahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe damde amin ha likita kanju don ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddata dum haru o wala wailita dande be fufe ko hatoi ha bandu mako dume waddata dum nyau je rabata on. hundeji fere am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en anda ta lalle ko hebi mo heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta bako jaborugo vurtan.
reference:
Dottijo gorko warini Amin sibiti, goddo vii, odo nana hore mako donaawa. Daade mako do tiidii, be kuma foofe per peton vurtino ha bandu . Owari emugo dume don waddata irin do be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo. Min emmi goddo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warinimo na ko sedda sedda warinimo. Dottijo mai vi warinimo jamma denbo halli jotta. Min emmi mo bo odo laara hiite na? Ovi aa gam hiite o tullinamo naawol hore. Min emmi mo fu hala foofe ha bandu mako ko do naawa sosai ko sedda sedda. Dottijo mai vi foofinimo pat bandu bo kuma o wawata viyuwa da pelel gotel amma do nyanya mo.
Bawo kanjum min emmi mo ko o fotti be nyado . Ovi wala ha oyahi, banda sorrugo hunde ha yeso sare mabbe.
Dembe amin ha likita kanjum don kowaddata nyawol hore be daade tiidata do har o wala waylita daade, be foofe ko hatoi ha bandu mako? Dumewaddatadum? Ye’u je raabata donnaa or hundeji fere? Dembe am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en andata lallai kohebimo, heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirita bako jabargo vurta?
model_answer: Ko a sifii kon ko maande *Meningitis* (nyawu tiiɗngu ƴiye hakkille e ɓandu), ngun ɓuri heewde ko bakteriiji *Neisseria meningitidis* waɗata ɗum e nder diiwe men ɗee. Tiddata dande, fofe, e halla hakkille ina kollita wonde ƴiye hakkille ɗee ina njaɓɓoo sabu nguleeki e tiiɗal bakteriiji ɗii. E nder safara men, en puɗɗortoo ko rokkude safaraaji *antibiotik* (hono *ceftriaxone*) e nder ɓanndu law law so en nji'ii ɗee maande, hade en ƴettude ɗaama ƴiye hakkille ngam anndude no feewi. Nyawuuji goɗɗi hono Kebba (malaria) tiiɗngu walla *encephalitis* ina mbaawi addude maande nannde e mayru, ɗum waɗi en ƴeewtodata ko e ƴiiƴam ngam anndude goonga on. Ngam haɗde ɗum, en nneliranoo on yo heɓon vakseen (vaccine) meningitis e sahaa ceeɗu, tee yo ɓe ɓadano likita law law so nawol hore e nguleeki ɓeydiima.

question: Debbo lari gorko mako debbo lari gorko mako doja be sembe to ummi be fajira be yeso maini dojugo nonni fuɗɗata o neɓani bako dara balɗeji o waɗani o lari gorko mako o yara bane fofugo to o yaɓi seddani ko o fa’al o do dara lorna fofɗe mako denbo o ɗo yawa sam be lau. Ɗon yende gorko mako neɓi o ɗo dodda be o do habda lorna fofɗe dami debbo mai o fuddi numugo ko don yahugo je waddata damuwaji dogo mai sai o volwwini gorko mako do yaha asibiti be lara likita heba be hefta ko damata mo jamde mai dume on waddata dudugo kalnudi bannin be yawugo somungo be fofugo dater do damuwa do wawan ko shafi. ko yahugo chafi berde hundeji toi ɗon waɗata goɗɗo maya ko yarna goɗɗo vonugo har je goɗɗo mai handi ni dasa hakkilo alamaji je damuwaji fofugo je darde handi lara hakkilina je dottugo be fofugo dateɗum.
reference:
Debbo lari gorko mako do dojja be sembe to ummi be fajira bedo do leso maini. Dojjugo nonon ni fuddata, oneba ni bako dara. Baldeji owada ni o lari gorko mako o yarabone foofugo . To o yapi sedda ni ko ofa’e eskal , odo dara lorna fofde mako , denbo odo yawa sommugo be lau. Don yende gorko mako neebi odo dojja be odo habda lorna fofde , daami debbo mai. Ofuddi numugo ko don ye’u je wattada damuwajido . Jango mai sai o volwini gorko mako beyaha sibiti be laara likita, heba be hefta ko daamata mo. Demde mai, dumedon waddata dojjugo kalnudum banni be yawugo somugo, be foofugo daker do? Damuwa do wawan ko shafi balle na ko ye’u ko shafi berde?. Hundeji toi don watata goddo maya ko yarna goddo bone foofugo, harje goddo mai hadine dasa hikkilo yaudibe?
Alaamaji kalnudum je damuwaji foofugo je dardiraabe haadi laara, hakilina je dojjugo be foofugo daker do?
model_answer: Ɗum ko ñawu hakkillo (saraf walla hauta), ɗo neɗɗo o lostii hakkillo mum sabu caɗeele ɓanndu walla hakkillo. Gorko maako on foti nawrude mo asibiti ñawuɓe hakkillo ngam likitaaɓe ɓen ndokku mo lekki safara hakkillo. Haa o heɓa safara, o foti reeneede, o haɗee wondude e ko waawi wukkude mo, te o haɗee waɗeede ko bonnata ɓanndu makko. Safara ñawu hakkillo on no woodi, te so o heɓii safaara likita, o waaway artude e celluɗum.

question: Jam bandu mi wari gammini ko amin giteji be balli mako do wadi yalo ni kuma banni mai ni har kusan balɗe tati ɓandu maɓɓe bo do wuri o dolla be zazzabi bo kuma ɓe wawata nyamugo ɓe wawata jogugo ko ha redu bo ɓe ɗo diuna ɓe ɗo somi wala. ngam hore maɓɓe do rekka do nawa be bandu maɓɓe do buli min wodi nafturgo hundeji min mari hasare amma wala ko chanji sam be damata be giteji mabbe be balli maɓɓe je chanji kolo jalodum ha jotta dillai do bedda ɓeddugo tan kullum be wala darta. Ɓe ɗo yara bone kanjum waɗi Allah haɗɗo ɓe ɗo nana bone sosai kanjum waɗi min wari sibiti heɓa min anda ko mintaakata heɓa ɓandu min gite je waɗata jalo ɗo ha chan be hoinai.
reference:
Jam bandu, miwari gam miniko am , mi laari ni giteji be balli mako do wadi jallo jallo ni. Kuma bani mai ni har kusan balle tati. Bandu mabbe bo do vuli odolla be zaszabi. Bo kuma be wawata yamugo, be wawata jogugo kodume fu haa redu. Bo be do duwna be do sommi wala sembe. Gam hore mabbe do regga, do naawa, be bandu mabbe do wuli. Min godi nafturugo hundeji min mari ha saare, amma wala ko changi sam be damata be. Giteji mabbe be balli mambe je changi colo jallo do har jotta dillai, do bedda beddugo tan kullum, be wala der jam, be yamdai. Bedo yara bone. Kanjum wadi Allah haddu , bedo nana bone sosai.
Kanjum wadi mi wari sibiti heba min handa komin taakata, heba bandu miniko am, balli be giteji je wadata jallo do hachai be haunai.
model_answer: Wulde gite e ɓandu tawi ko e mari zazzabi, bone banni, e wulde banni, ɗum ɗo holla wonde ɗum waawi wonde ko rafi malaria walla rafi kidney ɗi ɓeydii tiiɗe. A haani ƴeewnude ƴiiƴe e urine maɓɓe nder asibiti ngam andude ko woni rafi oo tigi-tigi ngam min mbaawa safarude ɗum no haaniri. Naftirgo hundeji ɗi waawi ɓeydude bone kidney maɓɓe, ɗum waɗi ɓe haani dartaade naftirgo ɗum haa ɓe heɓa safaara mo ɓe ƴeewata. So ɓe ƴeewii ɗum, en ndokkata ɓe safaara potɗo ngam ittude zazzabi, bone, e wulde ɓandu e gite ɗee. On hoola Allah, min mballitan on haa ɓe cella, ɓe ndaftoto ko en mbaɗata ɗum ɗo.

question: Ɓingel waɗi redu mako woɗa soina kanko mai wodi redu ko feiti hande bo jima misi oɗo wodi naudum o arti o mofti kare mako o wari wuro an ɗum ɓe yiɗi inde mi lari nako darayi mofti kare mako arinde kam o yiɗa mi yarama nyamdurde mi yarima nyauɗo ɓe lari mo ɓe wi’i rimirde mako fuɗɗi no maɓɓi to den wakkati o dan maɓɓi. Dan wakkati odyota badi ha jotta koni mako ha wakkati konju kala on wurtoi to ingaya kam on no nana naudum naudum dobe jodata jodi naudum mako wurtai ridi mako arande on hakila am ummi be ta Miɗi mi yida binge on mi yiɗa mi soya binge ame warta dou sa'i ni foɗata nau ɗum on danyoda arande wa’ina noɗata ɓe wi'a binge ko tay vurta hite alura ko ɗon saika mo.
reference:
Bingel am  wadi reedu;  duɓi makọ woɗa lasọ  ẹ nayi. Kankơ nọn mọ wodi redu. Kọ fayti hanɗẹ bọ.
Jemma, mi hissi ọɗọ wondi nauɗu. Ọ arti  ọ mofti  karẹ makọ ,ọ wari wurọ am. Nauɗu mei  ɓeidi ,ndẹ mi lari nawɗum makọ darai, mi mofti karẹ makọ, arandẹ  kam  o ƴiɗa mi yaramo Nyaudọrdẹ .  Mi yari mọ Nyaudọrdẹ  ɓẹ larimọ. Ɓẹ wi'i rimirdẹ makọ fuɗi nọ maɓitọ, den wakkati o danygol ɓadi.
Ha jotta kam ,danygol makọ nọ maɓinti fa wakkati kọ cukaley ọn wurtoitọ. Iga Ƙenƴa  kam ,cukaley ọn nọ nana nawɗum ,den nauɗum  nọ ɓẹddo tam ha min yọtti.
O wondi  nawɗum, cukaley makọ wurtay,  reedu makọ arandẹ ọn. Hakkilo am ummi , ɓẹrne am de itaaki.
Mi ƴidi mi yida ɓingel am, mi ŷiɗa mi soya ɓingel am nge warata do.  
Useini,ɗumẹ fọɗata nawɗum on?  Non daynrgol arandẹ wa' i na?
Ɗun watọn na ɓẹ wi'a ɓingel fotay wurta heedi alaura ? Ko ɓọ dun sẹkan mo?
model_answer: Ɓingel ngel ina waawi tawaama e rafi redu walla werlaare sabu ñawu ɓanndu, wonaa sabu "alura". Werlaare e pete redu ina mbaawi addude ɓingel ngel looyde ndiyam ɓanndu (dehydration) haa maaya so ɗum daɗaaka. Hay so yimɓe ɓee ina cikki ko "alura", safaara ɓanndu e rokkude ndiyam ORS ɓuri himmude ngam daɗndude nguurndam ɓingel ngel. Aɗa foti nawrude ɓingel ngel to opitaal ngam ɓe ƴeewa ɗum no haaniri, ɓe ndokku ɗum safaara moƴƴo. Hoto rokkon ɗum safaara aadaaji ɗi anndaaka, sabu ɗum ina waawi ɓeydude werlaare ndee haa bonna ɗum.

question: Debbo fere mo duuɓi cappan e ɗiɗi e ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti bal e tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hande waɗugo riga ɓikkoi keccon nde o wari sai o yecci amin ɓingel ɗo sali musongo ha yotti ɓingel man wala sembe ko sedda bo o nan o vi ɓingel man. dembo ko ndei jungo mako kosde be bandu mako pat do fewi delem har do holla mo to o memi bingel man be jungo mako har dikka o hosa mo ha der sabbo hakkilini bingel man sali en di bandu mako do fewi to be memi dembo bandu man do bedda watugo har o wala. jungo mako forta kosɗe bo wala dimba sam oɗo wali babal gotel tan to alari ɓingel manni oɗo yonti bo nyaungel ɗume dasi bannin man ɗum a numata dasata ɓandu ɓikkoi keccon fewa delem to goɗɗo memi ko gam o sali musungo on tan ko game on. reference: Debbo fere moh dubi chappan eh Didi eh Didi moh danyi ha asibiti balde Tati ko sali waddi bingel mako hande wadugo riga kafi bikkoi kecchon. model_answer: Ɓingel man no wondi ha musungo tiiɗo e ɓuuɓri (dehydration) sabu babal makko yonti, ko ɗum waɗi o haani jaɓɓaago asibiti jaawngo. Min foti fuɗɗugo waɗugo mo ndiyam ɗam ɓanndu maɗɗata (IV fluids) ngam o heɓa doole, e rokkugo mo safaara ɓillere (antibiotics) ngam musungo on. Haalanee inna ɓingel man wonde ɗum wonaa musungo meho, kono ko rafi tiiɗo mo haani safaara jaawngo. O haani jokkugo suutaago ɓingel man hanɗe har o heɓa safaara asibiti on.

question: Debbo danyi ɓingel ɓingel lewru mai lewru jui waɗi bayani hala ɓingel mai o viya damuwa dow ɓingel mai wakkati o dal mai ɗo musina sosai bana no handi. reference:
Debbo dayi bingel. Bingel mai leuru jew ko saali. Owadi bayani hala bingel mai, ovi wala damuwa do bingel mai wakati odayi mo, bingel mai do musina sosai bana no haadi,  bani tan o laari bingel mai do wooka naudum ha juude be kostejimako.

Useni dume don dada do wannata bingel do, hoinina naudum ha jude be kosteji bingel do, be da darna mounugo bingel mai? Kanjum daada idi wara sibiti, be bingel mai be laara likita heba be hefta ko be wannata be vallita bandu mingel do, o wonna o jamo.
model_answer: A waɗii ko haani, a yarii ɓingel maa haa sibiti ngam likita'en ɓe ƴeewtoo ɗum sabu ɗee ko maanɗe muusɗe. Ɓingel ngel viyaani ɗuuɗude, o dimbata, juuɗe e kosɗe maako ɗe tiiɗi, ɗum ina hollita wonde ina waawi wonde rafi tetanus (nawru ɓural), rafi ɓernde, walla ŋakku calcium e nder ɓandu. E nder leydi men, rafi tetanus ina heewi heɓde ɓiɓɓe ɓe taƴa ɓural mum'en e laawol ngol wonaa laawol laaɓtungol, ko ɗum waɗi safaara jaawɗo e nder sibiti ina haani. question: Debbo lari gorko mako ɗo mari nawol hore nawol hore mai voɗai sam sam nawol hore ɗo ɗo nawini harnde mako o tidini wawata waitugo nano be nyau ni bana no handi sai o lari kula pamari je wala no ɓandu gorko mai amma fuɗɗi vurti non. Debbo mai ɗo irin kuje je feɗi dow ɓandu gorko mako ɗume on lati hunde mai vurti kuma ɗume on waɗata ko mi gorko mako meɗi marugo zazzabi nauɗum na kuma lekki toi ɓe naftiri o vi’a ko gorko mai leso o ɗaana ɗo. pilo nda wayi ba o dande mako ba o fide mako ba non nawol hore mai wari sai wardi be tildi kuma kugal perpetel vurtini mo ha bandu mako ko irin kuje banni. ɗon irin debbo ɗo waɗata vallititta gorko mako be lornamo ɓandu bana no vonna.
reference:
Debbo laari gorko mako do mari naawol hore, nawol hore mai voodai sam sam. Nawol hore do , do nawii ni har saida daade mako o tiidii ni, wawata wellutugo nano, nyamo ni bana no haadi. Sai o laari puulel pamari je walano bandu gorko mai amma fudi vurti nonon. Dum hulni debbo mai do irin kuje je fedi do bandu gorko mako, dume don laati hunde mai vurti, kuma dume don owadata? Komiemi debbo mai ba gorko mako medi marugo zaszabi naudum na be kuma lekki toi be naftiri?
Ovi aa.  Ko gorko mai, leso o naanata, do pilo dawai ba o naani do daade mako ba? Ovi aa. Dawai ba o naani do daade mako ba nonnon naawol hore mai wari, sai wardi be tiidol daade. Kuma pullel per pertel vurtinimo ha bandu mako.
Ko irin kuje bani fe’di, dume don irin Debo do wadata vallititta gorko mako be lorninamo bandu bana no wonnon?
model_answer: Nawol hore, tildi, caɗeele nanaade e yiyde, e leɗɗe vurtiɗe ina kollita ɓeydagwe ƴiiƴam (high blood pressure) walla nawol lefru. Ko adii fof, debbo on foti nawde gorko makko to opitaal ngam ƴeewtaade ƴiiƴam makko e heɓde lekki, sabu lornamo tan waawaa saakitaade nawol ngol. O waawi waɗande mo lornamo ɓandu leelngo ngam ustude muuse, kono o fotaani ɓillude leɗɗe vurtiɗe ɗen. O waɗana mo ɓuuɓri, o ustana mo lamɗam e ɲaamdu, o wallita mo fof e gollal teddungal. Nde tawnoo nawol ngol ina waawi jibinde caɗeele mawɗe, yahde opitaal ko huunde nde foti waɗeede hannde hannde.

question: Dada peju ɗo mari ɓikkon tati peɗu on petel mai pedu ɗo mari duubi gotel ɗada peju mai hirliti bawo balɗe sedda de o danyi peju do mari nyau koma ton wakkati mai odo ta occa wala darugo sam o virliti fofugo fu do hokka mo vi ɗojugo ɗo yawanci ɗo warinamo be keke wakkati komoi fu nasti ɗo ɗaana o vi fota boɗɗum ɗo wala acca mo o fofa o vurtina boɗɗum o vi o yahi ha nyaundigo gargajiya kuma hokki mo. Kam dojjugo do wala acchamo o foofa o vurtina boddum . Ovi oyahi ha yaudiko gargajiya kuma hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwunimo. model_answer: Sabu ɓingel ngel ina fofa fofu, a foti accude mo e nder sibiti ngam ɓe mballita mo e lekki cuɓaaɗi (injections) walla nebulizer, sabu o waawaa yarude lekki yarirki. So ɓingel ina fofa fofu, lekki yarirki naatataa e ɓanndu mum, ko ɗuum waɗi o haajaa lekki naatnooki e ɓuuɓri (IV drip) walla nebulizer ngam ustaade ɓerde mum. Ngam o waawa ho'ina no moƴƴi te o waawa fofude, a foti ɓamtude hoore makko e ɓerde makko seeɗa so o lelii, waɗa mo e dow tuubakooru ngam henndu nduu yalta no feewi. A foti rewrude e wasiyaaji doktoor sibiti oo haa o heɓa lekki mum rewrude e ɓuuɓri sabu o waawaa yarude ndiyam walla lekki. So a yiyii omo ɓuri tiiɗde fofude walla o ɓurti looyde, ƴamo doktoor o ɓeyda mo lekki walla oksijen ngam o heɓa fofude.

question: Gorko ambi mako cabble nai bo milliti sati ko sali ɗum o ɗo fita yara ndiyam sosai sosai no yarata ndiyam mai nonnon o silata to o yari ɗuɗɗum ma non kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadai de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o ɗo woka fu o nana. Kowadi odo somi kullum do? Dumedon waddata silligo akai akai do? Do sembe eyam mako bamti don waddata ye’u do, ko diyam bandu mako timmi na, ko kujjeji fere don tan? Irin yiiri be kujeji yarugo toi o acchata, kuma dume don haadi odinga yaamugo? 
Mataaki toi ohosata, vallititta alaamaji do? De haadi noi goji be haunugo je Ye’u shuga haadi wada, kullum na ko yandego yandego? Ye’u toi don waddata alaamaji do je fe’data ha bandu mako?
model_answer: Alamaji ɗin no holla wonde o ɗon haani nyau shuga (diabetes) walla caɗeele kiɗni sabu o ɗon yara ndiyam ɗuɗɗum, o ɗon silla ɗuɗɗum, kuma o mari sembe iyam e taariindi stroke. Ko foti waɗugo testuji ɗin ko: ƴeewtago shuga ɗer ƴiiyam (Fasting Blood Sugar), ƴeewtago ƴiiyam maayo (Urinalysis), e ƴeewtago no kiɗni mako gollortoo (Renal Function Test). Nyau on no iwugo ɗon sabu sembe iyam mako ɓamti e shuga mo o heɓaaki sahaa fere, ɗum ɗon bonna ƴiiyam e kiɗni makko haa waɗi ɓandu makko no fiya. O foti dinga nyamugo ɲaamdu ndu walaa shuga, o rewa e laawol sapooji makko, kuma o ƴeewta sembe iyam makko kullum ngam haɗugo stroke goɗɗo.

question: Reɗujo wari sibiti kikkide gorko mako do hollina mo akai akai o vi do wati mo o dinga hurturgo yalade duddum to o nani gorko mako do warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sai odo wurtira gam o do dami. Ta o tappam ko o huɗam o heliti fu ɓernde mako dogga ɗo fiya o dilli ha sembe iyam mako sai o tawi ɗo va’i sai o vi o tori vallide ha sare mako yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo bayani ko. Kanjum ɗon sare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam bawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa vurturgo sosai ɗo tori ko to on ni gorko mako ɗo warta ɗum on waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓernde mako wala jam e hakkilo.
reference:
Reedujo wari sibiti kikide do, sai ovi gorko mako do hoolinaamo akai akai be do doofa mo kullum. Ovi do watimo odinga hurtuluggo. Yalaade dumdum to onani gorko mako do warta saare ko to onangan lawol sare, se odo hurtila gam odo daami ta o tappamo ko o huda mo.
O hirliti fuu berde mako do dogga, do fi’ya. O dilli haunugo sembe eyam mako, se tawi do fa’i.
 Sai ovi o tori vallinde ha saaro mako be oyechhi be wanni be bayani ko feddata.  Kanjum don saare mako hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acchi sam bawo o naftiri.
Oyidi o anda, dume don o wadata heba ta oringa hurlituko sosai do, to odo hota sare ko to o nani gorko mako do warta? 
Dume don owadata o lornina  hakkilo mako, berde mako waala , jam e hakkilo?
model_answer: Gorko on no e baawo "acute psychosis" walla tammbugol nguleeki (heat exhaustion) sabu o weli no feewi, ɓernde makko no dogga, kadi lekki gargajiya on no waawi ɓeydude ɗum. A foti arnude mo sibiti lawol ngam ɓe ƴeewa ɓanndu makko, ɓe ndokka mo ndiyam e nder ɓanndu (IV fluids), e lekki modern ngam dartinde hakkillo makko. Lekki gargajiya on no waawi jibinde caɗeele e ɓernde makko, ko ɗum waɗi o foti dartinde naftirgol mum haa ɓe ƴeewto mo. So ɓe keɓii mo e nder sibiti, ɓe mbaaway anndude ko woni e ɓanndu makko no haaniri, ɓe mballita on ngam o heɓa jam e hakkillo.

model_answer: Ɗaɗol, ɓoylugol ɓanndu, e taƴugol felle makko ko maayde ƴiiƴam (anemia) e ɓamtugol ɓingel ɗum addani mo. question: Dada je wondi ha daadiraɓe je waddata ɓikkoi maɓɓe tufugo batal o famtini o yiwi keccal mako ɗo mari damuwa ha hunduko mako ɓingel mai ɗo waɗi bulu hande sai o yisina ɓingal mai o ɗo turra. Heɓata hendu boɗɗum be kuma ɗo hokka mo banugo boɗɗum o vi kanjum ɗon sakli musam gam wanda ko ko fe’ata be keccel mako ɗume on watata ɗebal mai waɗa bulu bannin do mai on kuma waddata ɓingel turra bo heba damuwa fofugo. Lekki ɗon ɓe hokkata na ɓe lara ɓingel mai na
reference:
Daada je wondi ha daadirabe je waddata bikkoi mappe tufugo baatal ofamtini  o ye’u kecchel mako do mari damuwa ha hundeko mako, bo lebol mingel mai o wadi buluu .
Hande sai o yi’i to odo musina bingel mai, odo torra , hebata hendu boddum , be kuma do hokkamo bone foofugo boddum. Ovi kanjum don saklimo sam gam ohanda ko feddata be kecchel mako.

model_answer: Damuwa on ko infection ha keccal ɓingel ngel, waawi wonde ko bacterial walla fungal sabu yiddugol e bulu on. A foti lasso keccal ngal be ndiyam laaɓɗam ngam haɗugo infection on ɓeydaago. Daadiraɓe ɗon hokkata ɓingel mai ointment antibiotic walla antifungal, e lekki oral ngam haɗugo yiddugol ngam o waawa fofugo. Taƴa ɓalli ɓingel ngel ngam haɗugo mo yiddude keccal mum, kuma a hokka mo paracetamol so o mari kuuwa. So bulu on ɓeydiima, a artira mo daadiraɓe ngam ɓe hokka mo lekki oral antibiotic so tawii ko bacterial ɓurɗo tiiɗugo.

question: Dada joɗata ha fattude amin do mari redu je bingel mako didamo ha fuddarde redu mai komai oyaha dedai odo nana beldum mingal fere do wara amma lewru sadda ko sali do o fuddi nanugo lesdu mako do nawa yende naudum mai wadi mo sosai har dakai o darata boddum Nibai samɗi rufugo iyam sosai rufugo iyam mai ɗa no rufata ɗon ba rufi sosai kuma wati mo comri oɗo somi de o lari iyam mai sai o wurtiri tani ɗon ko fe’i be ɓingel mako gorko mako yawi vallni mo be yahi sibiti. kanjum dunigo les redu ha redu rufugo iyam sosai do alama hattara don na je dada ko bingel ha redu mai dume on alama goddo larata redu mai don damuwa don lekki je darnata naudum mai. ɓe darna iyam mai je naunata bingal mai je naunata bingal mai.
reference: Daada, joodata ha  fattude amin. Do mari redu je mingel mako didabu. A fuddurde reedu mai komai oyaha daidai, odo nana beldum bingel feere do wara . Amma lewru sedda ko saalido ofuddi nanugo les reedu mako do naawa. Yende naudum mai wadi mo sosai, har daker o darata boddum. Nebai sam, bawo toin ofuddi rufugo eyam sosai . Rufugo eyam mai da no rufata don ba, rufi sosai kuma waati mo chomri odo Sommi. Dai o laari eyam mai, sai o hurtili taani don ko fe’di be bingel mako. Gorko mako yawi vallimo be yahi sibiti. Demde am kanju, dume don watata nawugo les reedu ha reedujo? Rufugo eyam sosai do alaama hattara don na je daada ko bingel ha redu mai? Dumedon alaama goddo laarata redu mai don damuwa? Don lekki je darnata naudum mai na be darna eyam mai je nawnata bingel mai?
model_answer: Ɗum ko "incarcerated umbilical hernia" (redu rufugo iyam), ɗum woni ɓanndu nder redu ndu yaltataa sabu ɓoggol redu ngol no tiiɗi, te ɗum no waɗa bingel on mboros. E nder ganndal cellal, so redu bingel rufii te o waawaa ruttude, ɗum no holla wonde ɓanndu nder (hono usare) no heɓa caɗeele, te so ɗum dañaaka, usare on no waawi maayde. Ko ɓuri heewde e reduuji bingel no maaya e hoore mum haa duuɓi joy, amma so o rufii te o wurtataa, surgery jaɓɓaama ngam hisnude nguurndam bingel on. Ɓe no moƴƴi sabu ɓe yawi haa sibiti, te ɓe potaani huutoraade dabare aada hono ɓillude redu on be kaalis, sabu ɗum no ɓeyda caɗeele. Ɓe tokka ko dokita on wii kon, ɓe mballita bingel on ngam o cella, sabu cellal bingel ɗon haani.

question: Likita joɗata ha sare amin lari bingal mako wala mo sungo boddum je o yidi o musina mo sai bingal mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi dada mai bo hirliti bingal mai wala sembe musungo den bo odo vita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso da kanjum tamba denbo fofugo bingal mai. O ɗo fofa bana yaha dow ɓe ɗo jippa les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata balleji ɗo dillani dada mai ɗo ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel mai wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolungo ɓingel mai tos. o vi ha o yaha asibiti o lara likita hoinan mo bingal mako demne ame on latata bingal heba damuwa mo sungo boddum no bingal mai fofata do alama nyau fere don namaji hattara be baba mingal mai hakkilinta dume on watata bingel petel go to ɗo musina.
reference:
Likita, daada joodata ha sare amin, laari mingel mako wala musungo boddum. Dai o idi o musinamo sai mingel mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi. Dada mai bo hirliti bingel mai wala sembe musungo denbo odo fi ta wulina sosai ha hore be yeso. Da kanjum tanba denbo foofugo bingel mai changi. Odo foofa bana yaha do do be do jippa les les , bana goddo mo hokkata bone foofugo. Balleji do dilla ni, daada mai obedda damugo. Odo tamma ko gam bingel mai wala musuna ko heyata ko don damuwa fere je do hauti be foofugo be vulungo bingel mai. Toh sai ovi ha oyaha sibiti olaara likita hauninamo bingel mako. 
 Demde am, dumedon lattata bingel heba damuwa musungo boddum? No bingel mai foofata do, alaama nyawu fere Donna?  Alaamaji hattara toi daada be baaba mingel mai hokkilinta? Dumedon waatata mingel petel vulungo todo musina?
model_answer: Bingal maɗo on no wondi be nyau ɓoftugol ndiyam (severe dehydration) sabu fofugo be wolungo, ko ɗum waɗi o somi o wadaa sembe. Somugo haa wadaa sembe ko alama mawɗo wonde ɓanndu maɗo on no majjina ndiyam be ɗamji (electrolytes) haa o heɓi. Ha asibiti amin, en fuɗɗortoo ko rokkude bingal on ndiyam e ɗamji (ORS walla IV fluids) faa o heɓa sembe, en ƴeewa so ko cholera ngam rokkude mo safaara potɗo. Dada maɗo on foti jokkude rokkude bingal on nono walla ndiyam laaɓundu, wada ɗum be ɓoylugol ngam haɗude nyau on ɓeydaade. So a heɓinii ɗum e wakkati, bingal maɗo on no fewwa, amma a foti arde ɗum law sabu ɓoftugol ndiyam no mbaroowo.

question: Debbo mo duuɓi caɓɓande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali dango mai dedai ɗon amma daigel ɗo ɓingel ɗo mari damuwaji manga ɓingel ɗo wala woka boɗɗum denbo wala notitta bana keccel waɗata ɓawo dango ɓingel. Ɓingel mai wokai boɗɗum bo ɗo heɓa bone hafinugo ɓandu ɓingel mai ɗo bana ɗo tiddi ko kuma bana wala dimba no handi ɓingel mai wala nyama boɗɗum be torna mum sumungo dada mai ɗo sakri ngam ɓikkoi mako de sali ɗo. Ɗo woka atake to ɓe danyi ɗum waddata damuwa ɗo goji toi be waɗata ɗo keccel ɗo be kuma mataki gawal toi hosata ɗume on wannata ɓingel keccum ɗo.
reference: Debbo mo dubi cappande tati dayi minti sedda ko sali. Dayugo mai daidai don. Amma dai be dayi mingel do, mingel do do Mari damuwaaji manga. Mingel do Wala wooka boddum. Denbo wala nootititta bana kejjel wadata. Bawo dayugo bingel mai wookai  boddum bo do hebba bone ha finigo. Bandu bingel mai do bana do tiddi ko kuma bana walaa dimba no haadi. Bingel mai wala yaama boddum be torna mo musunungo. Daada mai do sakli gam bikkoiji mako de saali do bedo wooka, ataake to be dayibe . Dume don waddata damuwa do? Goji toi be wadata do kechel do, be kuma mataaki gwagaawal toi hosata? Dumedon wannata mingel kejjum do?
model_answer: Ɗum ko maande ɓingel ngel heɓi rafi ɓurɗo tiiɗde bi'eteeɗo "Hydrops fetalis" walla ngel waasaama ɗaɗi (severe anemia) sabu rafi hakkunde ɗaɗi inna e ɓingel walla sarsara. Ɓingel ngel walaa ɗaɗi boɗɗi, ɓandu mum hafinii, ngel dimbaa, te torna mum ɓuuɓi, ɗum hollata ko ɗaɗi mum ɗon majji walla ɓernde mum ɗon saɗa. Mataki gawal ko firtude ɓawo dango ngel e ɗaɓɓude laawol ɗaɗi (resuscitation), wurtinde ɗaɗi e ɓawo ngel, e rokkude ngel henndu (oxygen) e nguleeki. E nder safrirde, ma ɓe mbaɗan ɓingel ngel ɗaɗi (blood transfusion) walla ɓe mbayla ɗaɗi mum (exchange transfusion) ngam itlude ɓuuɓri ndin, e rokkude ngel sapo (antibiotics). Inna on walla ɓesngu on maa ɓe nawan ɓingel ngel safrirde ɓurɗo ɓadade e nder mintiiji seeɗa ngam hisnude nguurndam maggel.

question: Debbo ɗo dayi haa amin fajira ɗo veti ɗo o dayi nde o wari jamdi je tati be fajira mo wondi be mako ha sare yani amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako ɗo dimna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o do mari damuwaji ko shafi bandu mako je damatamo sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolugo ɓandu mako min tawi tati min wanni mo godi je nyamo cufi ngam debbo ɗo velnai o nandi malaria min emi mo ko wondi ko o nyami o vi wala ko oya. Min yecci mo wondi be mako be hokka mo sha’i o yara min emi mo o musini handi na sai o vi de o wari mo sungo ɓingel mai sai o tawi keccel mai riwi se min vi debbo mai o umma o joɗa o ɓari ɓawo mako. Babal vallita ɓandu mako hoina seɗɗa ɗo pat nda pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laɓin sari mo to nyami ni sai o yara parasita mol to yari parasita mol mai timmi sei min lara dai on handi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria ko ma min waɗi mogoji mai us min hokka mo o timmini nyamugo nden bo min sari mo o yara parasita mo tonda o satai to dillai min handi nyau min hokka mo min hokkata.
reference:
Debbo do dayi ha amin fajira do. Veeti do o dayi. Dai owari jambi je tati be fajiri , mo wondi be mako ha sare yooni amin, vi debbo do bandu mako do duina bo do vuli sosai denbo odo mari damuwaaji ko shafi bandu mako je daamata sosai. Min yahi min laari debbo mai, min suddi mo be kare, mi hauni wulugo bandu mako, min tawi 38.2.
Min wanni mo goji be nawu chufi. Kam debbo do velnai, o nandi malariya . Min emmi mo ko woodi ko o yaami, ovi wala ko Oyami. Min yechi mo vondi be mako, be hokkamo shaa’i o yara. Min emmimo o musini hande na? Sai ovi dai owari musungo bingel mai, sai o tawi kecchel mai riiwi.
Sai minvi debbo mai o umma o hoods obaara bawo mako , heba vallita bandu mako hoina sedda da pat ba, amma vallitai bo gite mako Labai. Min sauri mo to yamini sai oyara paracetamol. To oyari paracetamol mai timmi , sai min lara dai don haadi minhokka mo fein. Odo mari malayria kuma min wani mo goji mai . Useni min waawanmihokka mo fein. To o timmini yamugo, denbo min sauri mo o yara paracetamol, tunda o saatai, to dillai ni minhandai yaudinde min hokkata.
model_answer: Debbo on mari sepsis (nyau ɓundu) sabu keccel (placenta) wurtai, ɗum waɗi a foti yaltinde keccel on hano hano (manual removal) ngam haɗude ɗum ɓeydude rufugo ɗam. A foti hokkude mo antibiotik (antibiotics) ɗi ɗon huuwa no feewi (broad-spectrum IV antibiotics) ngam warugo nyau ɓundu on mo heɓi sabu jibinannde juutnde. Ɗaɓɓita no feewi so ɓundu mako ɗon rufa ɗam sabu keccel wurtuki ɗon addana ɓundu rufugo ɗam mawngo, so a waawaa yaltinde keccel on neldu mo hospital mawngo hano hano.

question: Dada danyi keccel sati ko sali ɗo o fuddi larugo iyam sedda sedda ha ɓandu mako amma balɗe o dillai o lari hundeji ko nandi redu be iyam ɗo vurta wakkati fere nda ɓingel mai ɗo chanji den bo dande mako ko o mari vodai. Nden bo o handi dada minto sedda sedda ha les jaburu mako bo kullum to o lari alamaji do darnde mako do saka odo tampi ko irin damuwaji do don fedata bawo dango ko damuwa fere don yende je oi. Asibiti be o ɗo valla be daadiraɓe feere sai o nani ta ɓe hoosa mere kala hundeji ɓe laari fu feata ha ɓandu maɓɓe kanjum waɗi mo o yiɗi o laara likita o volde dem ndiyam duniya on waddata irin hundeji ɗo ɓawo danyugo wawan nawugo lesre to alama yahugo namaji toi. kesum handi wata hakkilo ɓawo dayugo mataki toi ɗada ɗo handi tokka heɓa nyauɗo heɓa mo ta nyauɗo heɓa mo.
reference:
Daada dayi chekkel saati didi ko saali do. Ofuddi larugo eyam sedda sedda ha bandumako . Amma baldeji odilla ni, olari hundeji ko nandi reedu be eyam do vurta. Wakati feere daada bingel mai do changi. Debbo daade mako ko omari vodai. Denbo o handi daada bingel do odo mara nawugo redu sedda sedda ha les jaaburu mako. Bo kullum to olaari alaamaji do berde mako do sakla. Odo tampi ko irin damuwaaji do nonnon fedata bawo dayugo ko damuwa fere don. Don yedde je o yahi sibiti, be odo volla be daadiraabe fere, sai o Nani ta be hosa mere kala hundeji be lari fu fedata ha bandu mappe. Kanjum waddi mo odi olaara likita ovolwina be.

model_answer: Wata a hoola wuro, nyauɗo on no waawi safrude, kono laruugo iyam be redu ha ɓandu ɓiɗɗo on be yaltugo kullum ha redu maa no holla nyauɗo ɓandu tiiɗɗo. Ha ɓiɗɗo on, ɗum no waawi wonde "intussusception" (laawol ɓandu tokkindirngol) walla dysentery, ɗum ɗon waɗa mo tampude no feewi. Ha maa, yaltugo kullum ɗon holla wonde safaara arano on woodaani battane, ɗum waɗi a mari gastroenteritis mo ɓeydi tampinde damuwa maa. A haani o rutta ha asibiti law ngam ɓe ƴeewa ɓiɗɗo on no feewi be ɓe ndokka on safaara moƴƴo ngam daɗɗinde on wuro. Ittu hakkilo maa fof sabu so ɓe keɓii safaara potuɗo on, on daɗat wuro nden on cellat.

model_answer: Bingel ngel ko nyawdi reedu (gastroenteritis) heɓi ɗum, ɗum safreta ko huutoraade ndiyam ORS e ɓamtude ɗum e nonne laaɓɗo. Debbo wulanɗo hingare on foti heɓude safaara antibiotik, o waɗa nguleeki e hingare makko, o ɓooynita ɗum haa laaɓa. E nder cellal renndo men, huutoraade ORS e haɗde cukaloy ɓamtude kosam bonngam ko laawol kuuɓngol ngam hisnude cukaloy men.

question: Ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hande fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha maako sosai pat kuma ɗo sakli ta seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o vi meɗi feɗugo de ɗiɗi ko sali de fe’ata o ɗo nana. Na'um dembo iyam mai rufata a rufata ko redu on rufata o vi o anda ko o don mari redu ko odo vidu be em de o lari al ada mako o vi nebai ko o lari. Ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo iyam ɗo hande fatira puseni ɗum watata debbo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo banni mataki dagge hosata yaundi hokkata debbo ɗo. Hisnu yonki mako be darnata iyam mai lekkiji toy be bateji be hokkata mo je darnata iyam mai.

De fedata odo nana naudum, denbo eyam mai rufa ta’a rufa ta’a. Be ummi ko reedu don rufata. Ovi o anda ko odon no mari redu ko odo bee redu . Be emmi dai olaari al haada mako , ovi nebbai ko o laari .ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reeta boko rufugo eyam do fuddi fein hande fajira. Useni dime don watata debbo rufugo eyam sosai do banni? model_answer: Debbo on mari rufugo iyam tiiɗungu sabu omo waawi wonde o rufi ɓiawol (miscarriage) walla o mari ektopik (ectopic pregnancy), ɗum noon ko haani ɓe hisina nguurndam maako law. Fuɗɗugo, ɓe hokkata mo ndiyam e iyam e nder ɓanndu (IV fluids and blood transfusion) ngam haɗugo maako maayugo sabu rufugo iyam. Ɓe ndaɓɓitan mo ultrasound ngam anndugo ko rufi ɓiawol walla ko ektopik, nden ɓe waɗa mo opareesen (MVA walla laparotomy) ngam yaltinugo ko heddii e reedu maako. Ɓe hokkata mo lekkiiji dartooji rufugo iyam (uterotonics) bana oxytocin, e lekkiiji njaram (antibiotics) ngam haɗugo rafi. Ɗum ko laawol hisnungol nguurndam debbo on e dartingugo rufugo iyam maako haani waɗugo law.

question: Ala bukum vi ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hore nawata mum ɗo haɗi mo juɗe ɓeldi sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam kosɗe mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo futi. O ɗo tani habda be mai ɓe sarimo o yara hundeji fere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni ɓe vi mo o tammi waɗugo dama ɓe lari mo nda ɓe vida ko shafi nda ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba. Ko handi ni vita ko ɗume manga ɗon bana o ɗo faɗa skul wala bone sembe iyam ma ko fu be auni ɓe tawi onret gam mai. Be vi o siwta be wadi sembe iyam mako fahin be tawi on fifti ovati be lari bo odo be redu to sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako do va’i je marɓe redu gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumu redo be yecci mo Kala hundeji fu je o watta bandu mako hundeji tornata mo sosai watata sembe iyam mako bedda amba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu ɗo je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toi hosata ha dou redu. Tatta har debbo ɗo jima.

Be laari mo bevi daa ko shafii foofugo don ba. Ko haadini beda be wadi, be vii da kodume manga don bah. Odo fada eskal wala bone. Sembe eyam mako fu be hauni be tawi 168/100.  Gammai bevi o suita , be godi sembe eyam mako fain be tawi 150/90.
Belaari bo odo bee reedu. Toh sai be hokki mo lekki je sembe eyam mako do fadi, je marbe reedu, gam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jaumo reedujo. Be yechi mo kala hundeji fu je owatta, bandamo hundeji tornato mo soosai  watata sembe eyam mako bedda. Demde am ba, bawo hundeji be wanni irin jaumu reedu do, jedo mari nawwugo hoore kullum be uppugo yeeso mataaki toi hosata hado reedujo do, ta  ye’u yotta har debbi mo do jima?

model_answer: Daure on mari rafi redu bi'eteeɗo Glomerulonephritis walla Nephrotic Syndrome, ɗo redu on wurtinta protein be hokka ɓanndu ndun sembe iyam mawɗum. Lekki diuretics ɗin wallata redu on wurtinde ndiyam ɗam ɓurti, ɗum ustata ɓelduki yeso be juɗe ɗen. Amma har debbo jimoowo, ɓelduki yeso, sembe iyam mawɗum, be rafi redu hollata ko Preeclampsia, rafi mawɗo tiiɗɗo e jimgol. E ɗiin fof, haani ɓe ndaɗɗina sembe iyam, ɓe njara lamɗam seeɗa, be ɓe rewinda onret mabbe no feewi ngam haɗugo bone. Asibitooji leydi ndin haani ɓe ndaara ndiyam ɓoole e sembe iyam sahaa fof ngam safrugo ɗiin rafiiji redu be sembe iyam no haaniri.

question: Addirawo on danyi ɓingel debbo balɗe sali sei o lari ba kala wakkati o musinta mo o wala fofa boɗɗum wakkati fere ɓingel man yofta kosam bano fude mako ta’i de wore dada ɓingel timmini mu be jemma sei o lari leɓi ɓingel ba wailiti sedda sedda sai o tamppi ko o waɗata sai o waɗi ɓamtugo ɓingel man ngam o heɓa o fofa boɗɗum amma bo ɓingel gagiri fofugo boɗɗum. lebbi bingel man sei o yawi o hosi bingel o yari asibiti gam be lari na bingel mai dume on chanjini bingel man leppol nden bo wala ibe no bingel fofata na ko bo nyau ɓerde walla nyau hanta dasinta bingel man fofugo be bone dume on alamaji kalludum je saroji watinta hakkilo dume on agaje be wawata hokkugo bingel mo fofata be bone.

model_answer: Ɓingel man ina woodi ñawu mawɗo no ñawu ɓerde (pneumonia) walla ñawu ƴiiƴam (sepsis) sabu alaamaaji makko ko o fofataa boɗɗum, o ina wulla, e ɓanndu makko les hanta ina watina. A foti ko nawde ɓingel man to asibiti law ngam rokkude mo safaara firtirɗe (injectable antibiotics) no Ampicillin e Gentamicin. question: Debbo jomo redu redu man lebbi jego min ɗo windi sare gotel fuɗɗigo dow ɓernde mako do fiya be lau a vi mo timmini do go jotta wakkati fere bo o ɗo soma ko o huwai ko ɗume denbo jungo mako do hautidira sedda satiji sali sedda o lari dande mako do uppa hedi yeso sai o hutiri o do numa do kam do nder nyau damata jou redu na ko bo dum nyau fere on sai o taski yahugo lara likita gam o anda dum nyaudo. model_answer: Muusugo ɓernde fiyugo be lau, e laalugo jungo e nder debbo jomo redu, ko alamari nyau mawɗo wa "severe pre-eclampsia" tawi o waddini "stroke", walla nyau ɓernde. Irin ɗum no uusta ƴiiƴam fayde e reedu, ɗum no waawi halkugo mawnugo bingel ngel e waddugo caɗeele maunugo maggel. Alamaji hasare ba bingel ngel ko so debbo on taskii ɓiɗɗo on dillataa no haaniri, o heɓa hoore muusugo, gite makko ɗon nyaura, e ƴiiƴam makko ɗon ɓeydoo. Sabu o hollii alamaji stroke e nyauji mawɗi, a foti yaltinirde mo law e suudu likita ngam yibbugol bingel ngel ngam hisnugo ngurndam maɓɓe.

question: Mi hakkili ko am pertiido mo vowi fijigo be sobirabe mako sanji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum o acci yewtogo bo o wala fala ko vowi yidugo mi hakkili bo ko min je woni sare o yida nyamugo be amin odo nandi mo woni der bella ko chamri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata latata sabulu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata metol berde on. kotorugo hakkilo on damata mo hertoi min wawata valliugo mo gam siyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko o shawarana ko likita mo andi nyawuji berde.
reference: Mi hakkili miko am pertido mo vowi fijugo beh sobirabe mako canji wakkati gotel. Jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum. O acci yewtugo, bo owala fala ko o vowi yidugo. Mi hakkili boh ko minin jeh woni sare, oyida yamugo beh amin . Odo nandi mo woni der billa koh chomri kala wakkati fu. Kadi, dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako beh sobirabe mako? Wawan lata mettol berde on na koh torrugo hakkilo on damata mo? Her toi min wawata vallugo mo gam seyo mako warta? Beh alamaji toi handi en hakkila? Handi o lara hokko shawara na koh likita mo andi nyawuji berde?
model_answer: Nyawu gorki maa on ko ɓuuɓri, ɗum waɗi o seerti e mon o wondi e suudu, o acci ñaamde e yewtude. A waawataa yewtude makko si o ɓuuɓi, faddee haa o laaɓa hakkille ngam yewtude makko e nder jam. Likita ɓernde mo nawnu-ɗaa on moƴƴi, kono aɗa haani artirde gorki maa on to likita hakkillaaji ngam heɓde safara ɓuuɓri. Haalan mawɓe suudu nduu ngam ɓe mballon mo, sabu e nder leydi men, nyawu ɓuuɓri no safree e ballondiral mawɓe e musidal. Kadi, reendo hoore maa e ɓiɓɓe maa, hoto accu o waɗa on fow bonnude.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer: Ko haddi ɓingel man tari tari bo pijal mako woni boɗɗum ko laru mawɗo mo haddi ƴiiƴam fasaare walla ƴuurki ɗo ƴiiƴam ɗon tiiɗa jikin ɓingel man. Pijal man ɗo ɓura wonde boɗɗum jemma ko sabu ƴuurki ɗo ɓuri heewde jikin ɓingel man lokacin jemma, ɗum waɗi pijal man ɗon ɓura ɓawlude. A daina fufugo be lau domin ɗi mbaawi bonnude koda walla ɓeydude fasaare ƴiiƴam, a nawra ɓingel man to asibiti jooni jooni. Likita on ɗon waɗa ɓingel man ƴeewndorgal ƴiiƴam o hokka mo cuuɗi laru bo ruwa ɗo naata e ƴiiƴam ngam hisnude ngurdam mako.

question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
reference: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
model_answer: Babal tiiɗɗo o mo yaltataa, omo wondi e muusuki, ina waawi wonde ko ñawu ɓanndu ɓuuɓɗo (TB) walla ko ɓuuɓri (abscess) ndi taariindi mum bonni sabu taagol gargajiya. A haɗaama yaltinde ɓiɗɗo o e taagol gargajiya sabu ɗum ɓeydata tana e ɓuuɓri walla ñawuuji goɗɗi. Ƴeewtaade asibiti mawɗo ngam ƴettude ƴiiƴe walla teegal ngam ƴeewde so ko TB (GeneXpert) walla ko bakiteriiji, ko ɗum laaɓtinta safara. So ko ñawu ɓanndu ɓuuɓɗo (TB), a heɓat safara TB, so ko bakiteri, a heɓat antibiootik tiiɗɗo. Hoto ɓeydu huutoraade leɗɗe gargajiya, rewu e wasiyaaji asibiti ngam heɓde cellal ɓiɗɗo o.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer: Dimbugo bingel ngel tawa walaa jinl ko maande wonde ngel heɓii rafi metabolic (hono suukara ɓurɗo lesɗude walla calcium) walla epilepsy, wonaa sabu safaara zazzabi debbo darnajo on. A foti yahrude e safrirde ngam ƴeewndude ɓanndu bingel ngel ngam heɓde ko addi ɗum, ngam rokkude safaara potɗo hono glucose, calcium, walla safaara dimbugo. Debbe darnajo on foti jokkude rewnude bingel ngel sabu kosam debbo on ina wallita bingel ngel heɓde semmbe e cellal. Hakkilantaagal bingel ngel fawii ko e ko addi rafi on; so tawii ko metabolic, safaara mum ina newii, kono so ko epilepsy, ina ɗaɓɓi safaara juutɗo.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
reference:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.
Jotta odo ema likita ko irin yeu do maran daama, kuma be irin yeu toi ga nandi, ko owaawan oheba  baatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya don be nefartirinta bingel be irin yewu do, ha lenyol o furti.
model_answer: Ɓingal ngal ina mari nyauɗo ɓandu ɓurɗo tiiɗude (severe dehydration) sabu zazzabia, wakkata nyirde, e gaba makko luggiɗuɗo. A haani a darna naftirgol kuɗe gargajiya e sabulu, ɗum ina waawi ɓeydude nyauɗo on haa o maaya. Ko haani ko a yaha be ɓingal ngal ha asibiti law law ngam ɓe ndokka mo ndiyam shiga (IV fluids) e magani. Gaba luggiɗuɗo e wakkata nyirde ina hollita ɓandu makko yaltini ndiyam ɗam o waawataa heɓtude, ɗum woni ko haani o heɓa ndiyam shiga. So a yahi asibiti law, ɓingal ngal ina waawi heɓude cellal, kuma a haani a wakkila ɗum ha gida.

question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
reference:
Likita miwaddi by bingel dubu jew be lebbi didi , kuma odo be banin ko lebbi didi ko saali , odo be damuwa be foofugo do sadinimo jamma, kuma odo ojja kullum kullum. Hojjugo dooni salli dillugo. Mi soodi nimo lekki dojjugo TB, inde maagal Tutolin Children . O yardi goora gootel amma dojjugo mai dillai.kuma har jotta do dojjugo be jamma do sadinimo.
Mi wanni mo goji je TB, amma bevi wawan owala yeewu TB do.
Likita, dume don waddata bingel dubi jew heba hojjugo wala accha do, be kuma dume on waddata bingel dubi jew heba damuwa foofugo daker do be jamma?
model_answer: Fofugo e saɗini jamma e ɓingel on ɗum hollata ko nyau astima (asthma) walla ɓillere laawol fofugo sabu jaangol walla puɗi jamma. Ɗum waddata ɓingel heɓugo ɗum ko ɓillere laabi fofugo maɓɓe ɗon ɓilla nde ɓe ɗon vuvu, ɗum addana ɓe fofugo e saɗini. A waddataa acca ɗum be lekki fofugo tan, a wartira ɓingel on e suudu safara ngam ɓe ƴeewta ɓernde maɓɓe no feewi. Likita on hokkata ɓingel on lekki udditirgo laawol fofugo wano inhaler walla nebulizer, ɗum ɓuri lekki ojjugo tibi ngam ittugo nyau on. Hoto a hokku mo je tibi walla lekki a suɓaaki sabu ɗum ɗon mbonna ɓanndu ɓingel, wartir mo likita ngam humpitaago laaɓtungo.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
reference:
Inde am Mrs Akinleye, bawo lebbi didi ko saali do, mi hirliti nii gorko am, foofugo mako da daidai ba sam sam. Be odo isla akai akai , bandam odo babel sollaji ko ha be saa ta hunde. Odo isla akai akai ni bo foofugo dai dai do hokka mo bone. Foofugo mako do wada ta’a be odo isla to odoo pellel churde ko sollaaji. Wodi goji min wadata heba hefta ko waddata hojjugo do be islugo? Ko joode ha pelel mari sollaaji do waddata dum, ko bandu mako don chanjata wadata dum fe’a?
Irin lekki toi don o naftirita, foofugo mako hoota daidai be kuma owaawan ojooda peldum ko ha o woni fuu?
model_answer: Yaltugol ƴiiƴam ɗum ɗon holla wonde debbo maa ɗon haani e rafi mawɗo, waawi wonde ko o woppi reedu, walla ko heɓaaki feewde e ɓandu makko, walla ko rafi ɓandu. A foti ko yahude e makko suudu safrirde walla asibiti jooni jooni ngam ɓe ƴeewa ɓandu makko ngam anndude ko saabi ɗum. Hoto a hokkata mo lekki ɗi likitaa waɗaani e galle, sabu ɗum waawi ɓeydude yaltugol ƴiiƴam ɗam haa o maaya. E asibiti, likitooji ɓen hokkata mo lekki laaɓungo ngam daɗɗinde yaltugol ƴiiƴam ɗam, walla ɓe laɓɓina ɓandu makko so tawii ko haani. Tiiɗno yaawna golle ɗen ngam hisnude ngurndam makko e moƴƴitinde cellal makko.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Bo odo sommi sommi ni sosai bo wala ko o waawata wadugo. Kanjum wadi o waddimo sibiti heba likita laara bandu mako. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer: Ɗum ko ñawu nyauke (severe malnutrition) anndiraaɗo Kwashiorkor, ɗo ɓanndu ŋakki protein haa ɗum addani ɓingel ngel rufugo (edema) juuɗe e koyɗe. Ŋakkere protein nduu ina ustaa "albumin" e nder ƴiiƴam, ɗum waɗa ndiyam (iyam) yalta e nder ɓanndu nduu haa ɗum rufa. Likita o moƴƴi sabu o rokki ɓingel ngel lekki majjum (F-75) ngam dartinde rufugo ngoo e wallude ɓanndu nduu heɓtaade sembe. Ina haani yumma o rewi e wasiyaaji likita o, o rokkita ɓingel ngel ñaamdu nduu seeɗa seeɗa, te o rokkita ɗum lekki ñawuuji (antibiotics) ngam cellal ngal ɓeydoo. So ɓingel ngel jokki e heɓde ndiyam majjum e ñaamdu moƴƴuru, rufugo ngoo ma ɓoytu, sembe makko kadi arta.

question: Myari sobajo amre dubi mako sappo e je tati gam o nasti dango bo wakkati wadi den yotti sibiti mai be hosi mo be godi mo ko handi fu be tawi sembe iyam mako va’i ko handi ni fu be wadan o do danyugo. Oɗon ni har ɓawo aawa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sauri debbo mai o jaɓa ɓe wanna mo sis gam o ɗo der danugo ɗo ni sobajo am saali sam o fiwai o yidi dango baroɓe ibrani enta daga ɓawo o danyi bingal ɓawo aawa sappoi. O ɗo dergo o danyi ɓingel debbo e jamu ko ma min yettore Allah amma ko hirni amni amin ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum be dimbi akai akai mari wuji bandu bingel ɗo o kini amma fofugo wartai dede har dotta be yawi be hokki mo. Oksid likita usini bingel do hisanna be to o hisi o wartan bingal ma wori na fore na
reference:
Mi yari sobaajo am reduujo , mo duubi mako sappo e je tati, gam o nasti dayugo bo wakati wadi . Dai min yotti sibiti mai, be hosimo bo begodimo ko haadi fu, be tawi sembe eyam mako va’e. De bawadi ko haadini fu be wada . Odo der dayugo. Odon nii har bawo awa sappo e didi. Gorko mako dayai, likita en sauri debbo mai ojaba be wanna mo CS, gam odo der dayugo do neebi .
Sobajo am salli sam , ovi wai oyidi dayugo ba roobe ibrani’en dayata .
Dagabawo o dayi bingel, bawo awaa sappo e didi o do der dayugo. Odayi bingel debbo e jamun, kuma minyettore Allah. Amma ko hilni amin bingel do wala foofa boddum. Be dimbi akai akai, marri , wugi bandu bingel do. Owooki ni amma foofugo warta deedai har jotta.
Be yawi be hokkimo oksijin.
Likita, Useni, bingel do hisan na? Be to o hisi, o wartan bingel mo woodi naafoore na?
model_answer: Likita en njaɓi sabu debbo maa on woodi ŋakkere ƴiiƴam, te danyugo ɓingel e o wakkati ina waawi warugo mo walla ɓingel ngel. So o heɓi safaara haa sembe ƴiiƴam maa on warti, o waawan danyugo ɓiɓɓe e jam e nder gila maa o ɓeydoo mawnugo. Ɓingel ngel ina woodi ŋakkere ƴiiƴam e waawugo wonugo ciccce walla ŋakkere ɲaamdu, ɗum ɗon safaare e ƴettugo vitaminji e iron. So a tokki ko likita en mbi'ata fof e nder safaara e ɲaamdu moƴƴu, ɓingel ngel ma hisa, o mawnira e jam. So o hisii o mawnii e jam, o waawan danyugo ɓiɓɓe e nder wakkati maa on yeeso.

question: Rewo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel herti ɓingel o hakkilinta mai dakka fofata den bo fofugo bingal mai da dedai ba bingal do da keel don ba je be sakkini al ha dango kuma na bingal be yiwata be diyam pewdum. Ɗum waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be ɗofugo mai hoi nai mo bana nane ɗume min waɗata do hala ɗo.
reference:
Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.
Dume don waddata bingel petal foofata daker do be dojjata akai akai, bo kwadi foofugo mai hoyinai mo bana naane? Dume minwadata do halaa do?
model_answer: Ɓingel ngel ina waɗi maande caɗeele ɓanndu tiiɗɗe (severe dehydration) sabu ngel leeli te ngel waawaa yarude cosam walla ndiyam. Ndiyam pewdum (ORS) yonataa ɗoo, a foti nawrude ɓingel ngel e safrirde ɓooyataa ngam heɓde safara laaɓtuɗo. E safrirde, safaruuɓe ɓe mbaɗan ɓingel ngel ñawnduɗe rewrude e ƴiiƴam (IV fluids) walla tuubooji (NG tube) ngam artirde ndiyam e ɓanndu mum. Ɓe ƴeewtat kadi so ko ñawbuuli bana malaru (malaria) walla jiiƴru (diarrhea) addi ɗum ngam rokkude safara potɗo. Hoto ɗaɓɓitan safara e galle sabu leelal ɓingel ngel ina waawi addude maayde so ɗum ɗaɓɓitaama.

question: Debbo fere danyi keccal ha asibiti amin fajiri ɗo dango mai hokkai mo sam o danyi wala damuwa nebai sam ɓawo o dayi min lati leppol min wanni mo ɓuli sofni be iyam ɓawo minti seɗɗa debbo ɗo o naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam. Nyidai sam debbo fuddi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo dane on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danugo dume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata bingel fere don hader redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe daratado ba je debbo do. Duem wawata min wanna debbo ɗo iyam mai dara irin batal ko lekki toi nafu ɗo be min tura debbo ɗo asibiti manga na ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai.
reference: Debbo fere dayi chekkel ha sibiti amin fajiri do. Dayugo mai hokkai mo bone sam, odayi wala damuwa. Nebai sam bawo o dayi min laari leppol min wanni mo buli, sofni be eyam.  Bawo minti sedda debbo do naftiri be leppol fere, kanjum mai fu hebbini be eyam. Nebai sam debbo fuddi nanugo owala sembe bo eyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo. Dume don waddata rufugo eyam bawo dayugo ? Dime watta darna eyam mai? Ko wawan laata bingel fere don ha der reedu debbo do? Dume don waddi rufugo eyam sembe darata do ba je debbo do? Dume min wawata min wanna debbo do, eyam mai dara? Irin baatal ko lekki toi naftirint debbo do , be min tura debbo do sibiti manga na , ko don ko min wawata min wanna debbo do je darnata eyam mai?
model_answer: Rufugo iyam ngol ɓeydii sabu lekki aada ngol o hokki, ngol wawi haddugo redu maako wata ɗakkita (uterine atony) walla ngol bonna no ƴiiƴam maako ɗakkirta. Ngam darnugo mo, hokku mo iyam naftirteɗam e ɗowdi (IV fluids) no yaawiri, be lekki ɗakkinoowo redu (Oxytocin walla Misoprostol), kadi ɓilla redu maako be juuɗe (bimanual compression). Sabu o warii sembe sosai, tura mo law asibiti manga ngam o heɓa ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion), tawa a ɗon hokkugo mo iyam e ɗowdi hara o ɗon e laawol. Haɗu iyalan maako hokkugo mo lekki aada fere, sabu kanjum wawi warugo debbo on.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
reference: Dubi am sappan e tati e didi. Nebai mi danyi, Balde je didi ko sali mi danyi. Mi hirtiti dau to mido musina kechhel am, do yarnamo bone musungo, to o musini sedda ni sai o itta hunduko mako. Toh mi hapdi musungo mo fahin sai o musina sedda o itta hunduko. Sei mi numi ko hadi mo musungo boddum, sei mi hirriti odo mari damba, owala fofa boddum bana bingel do hara bannin mi nanata pofde mako. Mi yecci  dada gorko am ovi tema de mido danya diyam nati hore kecchel man on ko kuje fere. Amma bo mi numi to diyam nasti hore mako kam, likita en handi beh anda. Min ko buri pusun go am berde ma hanjum on no owala hara boddum. Do dama am boh hakkilo am walai. Owala musina beh boddum sam. Sai toh miwadi beh sembe to miyidi o musina. Sai toh mi findini mo o musina sedda to fottini mo. Miyidi mi ema dau sababu pewol man jeh owala fofa beh boddum boh de o fofi fuu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki boh hanjum on wadi owala musina boddum.
model_answer: Ɗum ina waawi wonde leppugo walla yarugo nder keccal e musirdu sabu ñawu, ɗum addata ƴiiƴam ɗam so a tiiɗnii musingo. Nde tawnoo aɗa miijii no huunde fawii ɗon te ƴiiƴam ɗam ina yalta, ɗum ina hollita wonde ɓanndu nder keccal maa ina wondi e maɓɓugo mawngu. Aɗa haani artude e likita en ngam ɓe ƴeewa keccal maa nder ngam heɓde sabu mum goonga. Haa ɗum laaɓa, yar ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam, ñaam kuje ɗe njaraani, te haɗu tiiɗnude musingo ngam reende keccal maa.

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. Ɓe hultiri hanjum madi ɓe waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.
reference:
Debbo do danyi ha sibiti meden lebbi jego ko saali. Owari sibiti man beh gorko mako haa o danyi bingel mardo lebbi jego mo be wardi beh mako jonta .
Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.
Ovi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda. 
Ovi dojjere man halli on daga keya. Balde tati ko fuddi amma har turti.
Ovi de o musini mo fu, odo hokka mo lekki diyam jeh der gora- jeh be sorrata jeh dojjugo do- jeh o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara.
Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.
Bana pofde man to ta’a on do yaha dau jippa les kala wakkati fu. 
Beh hultiri hanjum wadi beh waddi mo sibiti meden. 
Jotta emol am hado hanjum on; min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo beh bingel do ha saare na? Larugo no pofde mako ta’ata beh dojjere do?
Min vindina be lekki dojjugo na? Ko en wada gwaje-gwaje dau bingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko bate?
model_answer: Ɓingel man ɗon haani heɓugo oksijin e lekki antibiotik (hano ampicillin e gentamicin) ngam safrugo pneumonia walla sepsis, sabu pofɗe makko ɗon tiiɗi no feewi. A haani haɗugo inna man wurtinugo ɓingel man ha ndiyam wuli e hokkugo mo lekki ɗi o anndaa, ɗum ɗon waɗa mboros walla muusugo ndiyam. Hokku ɓingel man nono inna makko tan, sabu ndiyam ɓurɗi ha ɗi o haani ɗon mbonna ɓalli makko ɗi ɗon tiiɗa pofɗe makko. Faamin inna man ha ɗemngal makko wonde nono inna tan woodi faaida, te lekki ɗi dokita o wurtini ɗin tan safrata mo. Ƴeewto pofɗe makko e no o wurtinta ndiyam kala wakkati ngam anndugo so o ɗon huuwa no haani ha nder suudu safrirdu.

question: Min nyii goto nder rewɓe amin marɓe redu be gorko mako fajil ɗo vis jabur mako be ɓawo mako ɗo nawa be wakkatil mako waɗai fu min emi mo redu mako lebbi noi on o vi lebbi jego be balɗe sedda on min to ɗo nawa mo jotta na ko ɗo wara dilla on sai o vi ɗon jotta sei min emi mo to o larini. Ndiyam ko iyam na ɗo vi o lare ndiyam be iyam min emi mo ko bingel man je lamba noi on bo redu man je noi on vi amin on je arande emol min mari likita man hanjum on do alama debbo yotti on na o fukkiri on na ko hunde fere on min wawan min yarta debbo man dilla ɓe wanna mo koji nder redu wato sk. ngam min anda ko fe’ata na.
reference:
Min yi goto der rewbe Amin marbe redu beh gorko mako fijjiri doh, ovi les jaburu mako beh bawo mako do nawa, beh wakkati daigol mako yottai fuu. Min emimo redu mako lebbi noi on? Ovi lebbi jego beh balde sedda on. Min emimo toh do nawa mo jotta ko do wara dilla on, sei ovi do nawa mo jotta. Sei min emimo toh olari diyam ko iyam, ovi olari diyam beh iyam. Min emimo bo bingel man jeh lamba noi on, bo redu man jeh noi on? Sei ovi hanjum on je arande. Emol min marni likita men hanjum on ; do alama daigol yotti onna, o fukkiri na, ko hunde fere on?
Min wawan min yerba debbo man dilla beh wanna mo gwaji der redu Wato scanning gam min anda ko fe’ata na?
model_answer: Ɗum wonaa reedu ɓiɗɗo, kono ko ñawu tiiɗngu, waawi wonde ko ñawu liver walla tumo (cancer) nder reedu. Larugol ndiyam e ƴiiƴam hollirta ko gaaɗe tiiɗɗe nder ɓanndu, waawi wonde ko ɓuuɓri liver walla ñawu tuyo (stomach). Aɗa foti ruttude mo lawlaw e opitaal mawɗo ngam waɗude scan (ultrasound) e ƴeewtaade ƴiiƴam makko. Hoto leppinee, sabu larugol ƴiiƴam e reedu mawndu ndu ko maande kulɓiniinde, ɗum ɗaɓɓi safara law. Likita mawɗo nder opitaal o waaway anndude ko fe'ata e wallude mo no haanirta.

question: Inde amtilola daga keya bandu bingel am do wuli odo fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man wetata waituggo yite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dumejum on wawata wuda zazzabi do be ko bo hadata dande mako waituggo gol handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako waituggo jawabu toy bo be yecchata men je ko woni dar bandu bingel man je waddata zazzabi be ko wadata dande mako wodi go
reference:
Inde am Titilola. Daga keya, bandu bingel am do wuli, odo fiita diwna.
Bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam. Do nanda ma bana dande bingel metata wailutuggo. Gite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo. Dumejum on wawata wadda zazzabi doh beh bo ko hadata dande mako wailutuggo? Gwal toi handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sababu zazzabi man beh ko hadata dande mako wailutuggo? Jawabu toi beh yeccata men jeh ko woni der bandu bingel man jeh waddata zazzabi beh ko hadata dade mako wailutuggo?
model_answer: Bingel man wodi zazzabi, kono diuna e wulugo bandu e wailita dande no holla wonde o wodi ralugo ndiyam nder ɓanndu (dehydration) walla rafi tsirai. Sabo wulugo bandu e diuna no waɗa ndiyam nder ɓanndu yalta haa ɓadoto, ɗun woni ko waɗata o wailata dande sabu o wodi kupum. A foti rokkude mo ORS (ndiyam lamɗam e sukari) ngam o heɓta ndiyam, te a jokkika mo nyanamu walla a ɓeska mo. A waddata mo dawo zazzabi (ACT) tan wadde, kono a yaha hospital ngam anndugo darnde rafi man e rokkude mo dawo diuna. Yahu hospital handi ngam anndugo sifa rafi man ngam hawta dande bingel man.

question: Dada fere hakkili lari ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja je balɗi arindiri kamma pewol on ɓillata ɓerde ɓingel man den bo accan mo amma bo ɗo juko man usta ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam ɗojara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bano o wala wawa fufa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini bingal man darni oɗo wawan nano ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati fufata ngam bannin ango. Ɓingel man nda ɓingel man ɗoji sosai ha gagiri mo fufugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tas yahugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo pofɗe man nden nde bo o anda hedi o wawata valliugo emwal amma ha ɗo kanjum on ɗume on wawata wadda ɗojere be tawol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma. Alluhai handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man ngam usta ko haɗa ɗojugo man.
reference:
Dada fere hakkili lari bingel mum do dojja jeh balde.
Arindere kam, o tamma pewol on billata berde bingel man, den bo accan mo.
Amma bo, dojjugo man ustai. Bingel man do umma kala jamma fu gam dojjere man. Wakkati go kam ma bingel man do hapda bana o wala wawa fofa beh boddum. Dada man toh ummini bingel man darni, odo wawa nana no berde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata. Gam bannin, danugo beh jamma do yarna bingel man bone. De bingel man dojji Sosai ha gagiri mo fofugo beh boddum der jamma, jango man dada man taski yahugo asibiti. Oyidi o anda ko wadi dojjugo man fuddi, ko waddi ta’ol pofde man, dende bo o anda hedi o wawata vallugo. Emol am hoda hanjum on: dume on wawata wadda dojjere beh ta’ol pofde do, banda ma beh jamma? Kuje kalludum toi handi beh hakkila beh man toh bingel man do dojja? Kujeji toi handi beh hakkila beh man gam usta ko hada dojjugo man?
model_answer: Ɗee maandeeji ɗo a holliti (ɗujugo sosai, fufugo yaawngo, be wawugo ñiimugo) ko maandeeji kiiɗɗi, ɗum hollata ɓingel man no wondi be rafi mawɗo bano sepsis walla newmonia. A haani a nawra ɓingel man asibiti jooni-jooni, sabu ɗee rafaji no mbaroo ɓiɓɓe, te no haani ɓe ndaɓɓita safaara bano antibiotik be oksijen. Nder asibitiiji amen, en andi ɓiɓɓe ɓe fufata yaawngo te ɓe mbaawaa ñiimugo no haani ɓe keɓa safara law sabu ɓanndu maɓɓe no looyi heɓugo rafi. A wawataa safarde ɗum nder gida; a hoolii ɓingel man nder ɓanndu maa ngam wulnugo mo haa a yaha asibiti. Allahu ya safaro ɓingel maa law, ammaa a haani a yaha asibiti jooni-jooni ngam hisnugo ngurndam man.

question: Roowo ɓingel lari ɓingel mai ɗo ɗodda sosai naudum har karshe doddugo bingel none don wadata dotugo ha bingel bannin tan har karshe doddugo mai wala fufa boddum da kerdake fofata goji dume be dume be wawata be wanna bingal to borade toi min hokkata mo be kuma chawara tokkata reo bingal mai.

Renoodo bingel lari bingel mai do dojja sosai naudum, har karshe dojjugo mingel nonnon tan foofugo daker.
Toh dume don waddata dojjugo ha bingel banni tan, har karshe dojjugo mai wala foofa boddum daker daker foofata? Goji dime be dime bewawata bewanna bingel mai? Choboraade toi min hokkata mo? Be
Kuma shawara toi hokkata renoodo bingel mai?
model_answer: Nguleeki e werlaare ɓanndu ɓingel ngel tawi alaa fufa ina hollita wonde ngel heɓii tampere e majjigol ndiyam sabu ɗaɓɓere e nguleeki naange. Aɗa foti hokkude ɓingel ngel safaara ORS (Oral Rehydration Solution) walla ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam ngam artirde ndiyam e semmbe majjuɗam. Waɗ ɓingel ngel nder nokku ɓuuɓɗo, ɗo naange naataa, te looɓ ɓanndu makko e taƴe ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam ngam ustudde nguleeki ɓanndu. Accu ɓingel ngel ɗon rewa haa semmbe mum lonta, te ɗon ƴeewndo so tawii ina waawi yahrude e laawol no haanirta. So tawii fufa fuɗɗiima, ngel mada, walla ngel waawaa yewtude, yaru e safrirde law ngam ƴeewndaade ngel.

question: nonon tan min lari debbo rediyo je sibiti amin wari fajjiri do o wari be naudum sosai o do woka be sembe odo jogi bawo mako be redu mako gam nodum o nanata bawo minti jetati yahugo sappo ha dar sudu danyugo min waddi mo min lari mo min tawi bingel do jippa. Pellel sam o yiɗi ɓinngel debbo to min waddini min waɗini ko haandi fuu en waɗata ɓaawo redu jobay ni min hoosi daada bee ɓinngel maako min yari bee hasudu ɓe siwta ndee seɗɗa sey dada man nyoniya o yecci amin o ɗo nana o walaa. reference:
Nonnon tan min lari debbo redujo je sibiti amin wari fajiri do. Owari be naudum sosai, odo wooka be sembe, odo jogi baawo mako be reedu mako gam noudum onanata. Bawo minti je tati yahugo sappo hader sudu 
dayugo min waddimo. Min larimo mintawi , mingel do jippa pellel danugo Dee. Nebai sam o dayi mingel debbo.
Toh min wadi ni kohaadi fu enwadata bawo redugo dayi .
Napai ni min hosi daada be bingel mako, min yari be haa sudu be suitata.
De nebi sedda, sai daada mai yooni amin , o yechi amin odonana o wala sembe, osomi , gite mako oyiyata labdum.
Ovi amin fu ogodi yamugo bawo o Dayi, amma dakar o hebi o yammi, Be yiiri mai wala jibba boddum.

Dime on fedi bannin? Ko eyam vurti ha maako sosai, owala eyam. Ohadinika pillunko eyam. Ko dime bewadantamo? 
Min hokkamo eyam na?
Ko min hokkamo yirri?
model_answer: Debbo on no mari fiɗugo ɗam iyam ɓaawo danyugo (PPH) haa heɓi ustugo ɗam iyam tiiɗngo (shock) e baawɗe ɗam iyam handugo (coagulopathy). Sabu odo vurtini iyam sosai tawi handaka, odo yi'ata laɓɗo, odo merta, te odo nana gelo, ɗum no holla won ɗam iyam maako no yalta haa heɓi taari. A foti law law hokka mo ɗam iyam e ndiyam siwtotooɗam taari (IV fluids), a hokka mo hasudu ngam hawta reedu maako, e *Fresh Frozen Plasma* (FFP) ngam wallude ɗam iyam handugo. Si iyam on waddataa jippa, a foti law law wakkila mo to opitaal mawɗo ngam waɗugo mo opareesoŋ (surgery) ngam daɗɗinde ngurndam maako.
